title: EM9305 ArcTimer0/1 typo-RAM 4-byte grow, typo-install, typed ini_record_335820, and p-arctimer-ini paired sims
reason: Grow the 1-byte 801904/801908 objects that ArcTimer word-loads (same UB as 80faec/80fde0 hook slots), typo-install those handlers, and type ini_record_335820 as the NVM_InitCopy table by destination.

arctimer_grow.stock_access_width: Lowered stock is a 32-bit load in both handlers: ArcTimer0 `ld r0,[0x801904]` then breq_s/jl_s; ArcTimer1 `ld r0,[0x801908]` then the same. EM_IRQ_CALL_SLOT is EM_R32. No byte-width accesses or literals at 0x801905-0x801907 or 0x801909-0x80190b were found in g2/src/em9305. The GPIO slot at 0x80190c is also stored as uint32_t in em9305_link_closure.c.
arctimer_grow.change: Grew em9305_ram_801904 and em9305_ram_801908 from 1-byte u8 objects to 4-byte unions {uint32_t u32_801904; uint8_t u8_801904;} and the same for 801908, with offsetof and sizeof==4 asserts. The implicit 3-byte gaps after each object are now part of the object. Left as two adjacent objects (not merged into em9305_ram_80190c, which already overlaps 801944). ld symbols and addresses unchanged.

ArcTimer0.installed: em9305_ram_801904.u32_801904 (CALL_SLOT expanded to a named-field call)

pmlsvld_80fde0: Left as EM_R32(0x80fde0u). The loaded value only feeds a documented dead flags-gated reload; address mutants survived.

ini_record_335820.model: Version-2 NVM_InitCopy / stock_30ef44 table. application_boot.c is the only caller (stock_30ef44(record, flag, 1, 1)). Signature INI + version 2; entries start at +4. Walk of stock ble_em9305.bin application record at 0x335820 (936 B) yields four entries plus the end marker; no leftover after +0x3a8.

entries.covers: 2-byte 8012b8 object (s8_8012b8/s8_8012b9, proved by init_native_child_310200), 6-byte hole 0x8012ba..0x8012bf (no typo-RAM object), then em9305_ram_8012c0 through u8_8012fc. Two relocated code pointers sit at 0x8012e4 and 0x8012f0, which the dest object still types as u8+gap; they stay symbols in the record.

15 typo-RAM objects 0x80faec..0x80fdf4. 23 code/rodata pointers are symbols. 12 typo-RAM addresses with no named field yet are left as integer literals (0x80fb64, 0x80fb80, 0x80fd20, 0x80fd60, 0x80fd74, 0x80ff54, 0x80110c, 0x8011c8, 0x8011f8, 0x801248, 0x801250, 0x8012a0). Remaining words are unproved table/scalar data and stay literals.

The rest of the 64-byte 80fde0 object: two zero words then the nine hook slots (application_main, stock_30ecf8, stock_31114c, QF_onResumeInternalHook, stock_3111a0, qf_on_startup_internal_hook, stock_31161c, QK_onIdleInternalHook, stock_3117e8), typo-proved as u32 in the earlier 80fde0 grow.
BSS clear 0x801300..0x806080. Dest is a named field at offsetof 0x40 of em9305_ram_8012c0.

byte_compare_unlinked.detail: Compiled stock_residual_data.c with the unit's pbuild flags. Non-relocated bytes of the 936 B record are identical to stock firmware (ble_em9305.bin application at 0x335820). The 38 differing words are exactly the R_ARC_32 sites (4 dest typo-RAM relocs, including em9305_ram_80fde0+0x14 and em9305_ram_8012c0+0x40, plus the same 34 code/rodata pointer symbols as the previous verbatim record).

byte_compare_linked.detail: p-arctimer-ini app.bin and the linked 936 B record are byte-identical to p-irqtypo (sha 1d838a0ec140e1f1cfdcd2536db32b2ea2d15efc0fb3d2b102d7c38c05c132d5). The typed source therefore emits the same walker input as the previous proven record. Versus stock, the only differences remain the relocated code-pointer values (addresses moved in the reconstruction); dest typo-RAM addresses and all literal payload bytes match stock.

tree_build.note: Application payload is bit-identical to p-irqtypo: ArcTimer typo-RAM loads assemble to the same addresses, and the typed ini_record links to the same bytes. The ELF hash differs (debug/metadata); .text and the 3-record package payloads do not.

sims.renode: g2-firmware-emulator scripts/run-renode.sh, Renode 1.17.0, 8 s virtual runs, 1200 s wall cap
sims.image_note: Package and NOR are bit-identical to p-irqtypo, which already passed. Sims were still rerun on the p-arctimer-ini resc files.

remaining.tail_3357e0: Not started. 64 B verbatim immediately before the ini_record in .rodata.opencfw_em9305_stock_data.
remaining.radio_rodata: Not started. 700 B verbatim radio and small rodata tables at 0x333e9a in the same section.
remaining.typo_window_shims: Not started. Known next: residual_code EM_CONFIG_PTR / EM_IRQ_SAVE_PTR / EM_RF_CFG_PTR and &obj+offset shims (including 80fb64 in gap_80fb61, which is also an untyped typo-RAM literal in the ini_record e1 payload); boot QF_maxPool_ for 0x801360; 80ff6c/80ffa8 only after RAMHI/ROM check.
